web-guide-idea-104.audience: People who enjoy everyday cooking company.
web-guide-idea-104.offer: Go live during a manageable part of your normal meal preparation. This is a kitchen diary with conversation, so describe it honestly rather than selling a full cooking class.
web-guide-idea-104.steps.0: Prepare the phone before handling food.
web-guide-idea-104.steps.1: Introduce the meal and chat at safe pauses.
web-guide-idea-104.steps.2: Show the result and close before private mealtime.
web-guide-idea-104.equipment: A phone, stand and ordinary kitchen equipment. Keep cables clear of heat and water.
web-guide-idea-104.returnReason: Regular viewers can follow your weekday meals and seasonal ingredients.
web-guide-idea-104.promotion: Post the meal you plan to make and whether you will explain steps or mostly chat.
web-guide-idea-104.metadataTitle: Meri Rasoi — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · avaTOK
web-guide-idea-104.metadataDescription: Go live while preparing everyday meals and chat with viewers between kitchen tasks. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
